original_human_claim.text: Your accumulated attention is part of the work itself. What drew you somewhere, what you suspected, what kept recurring, what the agents pursued, and how the evidence changed the question all belong in the reservoir. A closed issue, local file, failed experiment, unmerged branch or irritated comment can carry important context. Its origin tells us how to interpret it, rather than deciding whether it deserves a place.

model_reformulation.text: A salvage operation that selected worthwhile findings from questionable artifacts; a findings-and-code review of the retrospective's 79 trails and the repository's Git ledger.

origin.author: repository owner describing the earlier model framing in the same message
origin.note: The owner's account of how the task had been treated before the correction; the model's own wording is not preserved here.

reason_for_rejection: The reformulation decided admission by the worth of an artifact and dropped the history of attention around it: the observation that prompted a guess, the alternatives considered, the evidence that corrected it, and the distinction between the owner's original curiosity and the narrower story an agent tried to prove.
missing_distinction: Origin governs interpretation; it does not govern admission. Agent repetition preserves the history of an idea without strengthening it, while independent observations can strengthen its evidentiary basis. (This sentence is the session's paraphrase; the owner's words are in original_human_claim.)
